{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017x8nowFNP4n34fDJmkN68f","type":"tool_result","content":"=== app_server/__init__.py\n\"\"\"Flask application factory for ReadingList.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom flask import Flask\n\nfrom persistence import open_database\n\nfrom .config import Config\nfrom .routes.books import books\nfrom .routes.pages import pages\n\n\ndef create_app(config: Config | None = None) -> Flask:\n    \"\"\"Build the application. Routes come only from registered blueprints; no schema is applied here.\"\"\"\n    config = config or Config.load()\n    app = Flask(__name__)\n    app.extensions[\"db\"] = open_database(config.database_dsn)\n    app.register_blueprint(pages)\n    app.register_blueprint(books)\n    return app\n=== app_server/config.py\n\"\"\"Typed runtime settings. This module is the only reader of the process environment.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nDEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH = \"data/app.db\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Config:\n    \"\"\"Settings resolved once at startup. DATABASE_URL overrides DATABASE_PATH.\"\"\"\n\n    database_dsn: str\n\n    @classmethod\n    def load(cls, environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> \"Config\":\n        env = os.environ if environ is None else environ\n        dsn = env.get(\"DATABASE_URL\") or env.get(\"DATABASE_PATH\") or DEFAULT_DATABASE_PATH\n        return cls(database_dsn=dsn)\n=== app_server/routes/__init__.py\n\"\"\"HTTP blueprints. Each module holds one blueprint and no business logic.\"\"\"\n=== app_server/routes/books.py\n\"\"\"Book routes: parse HTTP input, call the book service, and shape the HTTP response.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import asdict\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom flask import Blueprint, current_app, jsonify, request\n\nfrom app_server.services import books as book_service\n\nbooks = Blueprint(\"books\", __name__)\n\n\n@books.post(\"/books\")\ndef post_book() -> tuple[Any, int]:\n    payload = request.get_json(silent=True)\n    if not isinstance(payload, dict):\n        payload = {}\n    db = current_app.extensions[\"db\"]\n    try:\n        book = book_service.add_book(db, payload.get(\"title\"), payload.get(\"author\"))\n    except ValueError as error:\n        return jsonify({\"error\": str(error)}), 400\n    return jsonify(asdict(book)), 201\n\n\n@books.get(\"/books\")\ndef get_books() -> tuple[Any, int]:\n    db = current_app.extensions[\"db\"]\n    return jsonify([asdict(book) for book in book_service.list_books(db)]), 200\n\n\n@books.delete(\"/books/<int:book_id>\")\ndef delete_book(book_id: int) -> tuple[Any, int]:\n    db = current_app.extensions[\"db\"]\n    if not book_service.remove_book(db, book_id):\n        return jsonify({\"error\": f\"no book with id {book_id}\"}), 404\n    return \"\", 204\n=== app_server/routes/pages.py\n\"\"\"Application-level routes: the health check.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom flask import Blueprint, Response, jsonify\n\npages = Blueprint(\"pages\", __name__)\n\n\n@pages.get(\"/health\")\ndef health() -> tuple[Response, int]:\n    return jsonify({\"status\": \"ok\"}), 200\n=== app_server/services/__init__.py\n\"\"\"Business services. Each module holds behavior and takes the database handle as an argument; none imports Flask.\"\"\"\n=== app_server/services/books.py\n\"\"\"Book behavior: validate submissions, then store, list, and remove books through ``db.books``.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom persistence import Database\nfrom persistence.schema import Book\n\n__all__ = [\"add_book\", \"list_books\", \"remove_book\", \"validate_book_input\"]\n\n\ndef validate_book_input(title: str | None, author: str | None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Raise ValueError naming each field that is missing, not text, or blank after stripping.\"\"\"\n    blank = [\n        name\n        for name, value in ((\"title\", title), (\"author\", author))\n        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip()\n    ]\n    if blank:\n        raise ValueError(f\"{' and '.join(blank)} must be non-empty text\")\n\n\ndef add_book(db: Database, title: str | None, author: str | None) -> Book:\n    \"\"\"Validate the submission, then store exactly the title and author supplied.\"\"\"\n    validate_book_input(title, author)\n    return db.books.create(title=title, author=author)\n\n\ndef list_books(db: Database) -> list[Book]:\n    \"\"\"Return every stored book in the order it was added.\"\"\"\n    return db.books.list()\n\n\ndef remove_book(db: Database, book_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the book and return True; return False and change nothing for an unknown id.\"\"\"\n    if db.books.get(id=book_id) is None:\n        return False\n    db.books.delete(id=book_id)\n    return True\n=== \"remove_book\", \"validate_book_input\"]\n\n\ndef validate_book_input(title: str | None, author: str | None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Raise ValueError naming each field that is missing, not text, or blank after stripping.\"\"\"\n    blank = [\n        name\n        for name, value in ((\"title\", title), (\"author\", author))\n        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip()\n    ]\n    if blank:\n        raise ValueError(f\"{' and '.join(blank)} must be non-empty text\")\n\n\ndef add_book(db: Database, title: str | None, author: str | None) -> Book:\n    \"\"\"Validate the submission, set(operation.inputs))\n\"\"\"List books: GET /books answers 200 with every stored book in the order it was added.\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom flask.testing import FlaskClient\n\nfrom app_server import create_app\nfrom app_server.config import Config\n\n\ndef _add(client: FlaskClient, title: str) -> int:\n    return client.post(\"/books\", json={\"title\": title, \"author\": \"A\"}).get_json()[\"id\"]\n\n\ndef test_get_on_empty_store_answers_200_with_empty_array(fresh_client: FlaskClient) -> None:\n    response = fresh_client.get(\"/books\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.get_json() == []\n\n\ndef test_list_returns_titles_in_the_order_they_were_added(fresh_client: FlaskClient) -> None:\n    titles = [\"Ulysses\", \"Dune\", \"Emma\"]\n    for title in titles:\n        _add(fresh_client, title)\n\n    listed = fresh_client.get(\"/books\").get_json()\n\n    assert [book[\"title\"] for book in listed] == titles\n\n\ndef test_list_returns_added_ids_in_submission_order(fresh_client: FlaskClient) -> None:\n    created = [_add(fresh_client, f\"Book {n}\") for n in range(4)]\n\n    listed_ids = [book[\"id\"] for book in fresh_client.get(\"/books\").get_json()]\n\n    assert listed_ids == created\n\n\ndef test_each_listed_book_carries_id_title_and_author(fresh_client: FlaskClient) -> None:","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"87686774-575c-48c7-a9ec-695c87fe9eac","uuid":"ea186c8c-3195-4200-83f6-f75298e0c0f5","timestamp":"2026-10-23T18:03:10.357Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"134:    def select(self, table: str, columns: Sequence[str], predicate: Sequence[str]) -> str:\n177:        granted = \", \".join(sorted(self._operations))\n183:            granted = \", \".join(sorted(self._operations)) or \"none\"\n264:        unknown = sorted(set(arguments) - flask import Blueprint, Response, current_app, jsonify, redirect, render_template, request, url_for\n\nfrom app_server.services import books as book_service\n\npages = Blueprint(\"pages\", book_service.remove_book(current_app.extensions[\"db\"], book_id)\n    return redirect(url_for(\"pages.index\"), code=303)\n\n\ndef _render_reading_list(\n    error: str | None = None, title: str | items: list[_Item] = field(default_factory=list)\n    error: str | None = None\n    inputs: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    form_actions: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    script_tags: int = 0\n    shows_no_books_message: bool = False\n\n\nclass _PageParser(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"Collects the page's structure: list items, the error region, form fields, and self._in_empty_message = False\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:\n        attributes = dict(attrs)\n        if tag == \"script\":\n            self.page.script_tags += 1\n        elif tag == \"form\":\n            self.page.form_actions.append(attributes.get(\"action\") or \"\")\n            if self._item is not None:\n                self._item.remove_action = attributes.get(\"action\")\n        elif tag == \"input\":\n            self.page.inputs[attributes.get(\"name\") or \"\"] = attributes.get(\"value\") or \"\"\n        elif tag == \"li\":\n            self._item = _Item()\n        elif tag == \"span\" and self._item is not None:\n            self._capture = attributes.get(\"class\")\n        elif tag == \"p\" and attributes.get(\"role\") == \"alert\":\n            self._capture = \"error\"\n            self.page.error = \"\"\n        elif tag == \"p\":\n            self._in_empty_message = True\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:\n        if tag == \"li\" and self._item is not None:\n            self.page.items.append(self._item)\n            self._item = None\n        elif tag in (\"span\", \"p\"):\n            self._capture = None\n            self._in_empty_message = False\n\n    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:\n        if self._capture == \"title\" and self._item is not None:\n            self._item.title += data\n        elif self._capture == \"author\" and self._item is not None:\n            self._item.author += data\n        elif self._capture == \"error\" and self.page.error is not None:\n            self.page.error += data\n        elif self._in_empty_message and data.strip() == \"No books yet.\":\n            self.page.shows_no_books_message = True\n\n\ndef _page(client: FlaskClient) -> _Page:\n    response = client.get(\"/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    parser = _PageParser()\n    parser.feed(response.get_data(as_text=True))\n    return parser.page\n\n\ndef _add(client: FlaskClient, title: str, author: str = \"A\") -> int:\n    return client.post(\"/books\", json={\"title\": test_index_answers_200_with_html(fresh_client: FlaskClient) -> None:\n    response = fresh_client.get(\"/\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.mimetype == \"text/html\"\n\n\ndef test_index_on_empty_store_shows_no_books_message(fresh_client: FlaskClient) -> None:\n    page = _page(fresh_client)\n\n    assert page.items == []\n    assert page.shows_no_books_message is True\n\n\ndef test_index_with_books_does_not_show_empty_message(fresh_client: FlaskClient) -> None:\n    _add(fresh_client, \"Dune\")\n\n    assert _page(fresh_client).shows_no_books_message is False\n\n\ndef test_index_lists_each_book_with_its_title_and_author(fresh_client: FlaskClient) -> None:\n    _add(fresh_client, \"Dune\", \"Frank Herbert\"),\n        (\"Emma\", \"Jane Austen\"),\n    ]\n\n\ndef test_index_lists_books_in_the_order_they_were_added(fresh_client: FlaskClient) -> None:\n    titles = [\"Zebra\", \"Apple\", script_tags: int = 0\n    shows_no_books_message: bool = False\n\n\nclass _PageParser(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"Collects the page's structure: list items, the error region, form fields, and scripts.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.page = _Page()\n        self._item: _Item | None = None\n        self._capture: str | None = None\n        self._in_empty_message = False\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:\n        attributes = dict(attrs)\n        if tag == \"script\":\n            self.page.script_tags += 1\n        elif tag == \"form\":\n            self.page.form_actions.append(attributes.get(\"action\") or \"\")\n            if self._item is not None:\n                self._item.remove_action = attributes.get(\"action\")\n        elif tag == \"input\":\n            self.page.inputs[attributes.get(\"name\") or \"\"] = attributes.get(\"value\") or \"\"\n        elif tag == \"li\":\n            self._item = _Item()\n        elif tag == \"span\" and self._item is not None:\n            self._capture = attributes.get(\"class\")\n        elif tag == \"p\" and attributes.get(\"role\") == \"alert\":\n            self._capture = \"error\"\n            self.page.error = \"\"\n        elif tag == \"p\":\n            self._in_empty_message = True\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:\n        if tag == \"li\" and self._item is not None:\n            self.page.items.append(self._item)\n            self._item = None\n        elif tag in (\"span\", \"p\"):\n            self._capture = None\n            self._in_empty_message = False\n\n    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:\n        if self._capture == \"title\" and self._item is not None:\n            self._item.title += data\n        elif self._capture == \"author\" and self._item is not None:\n            self._item.author += data\n        elif self._capture == \"error\"
